description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for verifying the behavior of Git's diff context settings. It sets up test cases, modifies files, and checks output to ensure that diff context configuration options are handled correctly.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and checks their output.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies specific configuration variables in the environment.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file or output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
